digest.component_or_area: CI test selection and workflow routing
propositions: Nineteen OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite their input and expected results being independent of platform and Python version.

A strict repo_policy pytest marker should be registered and applied exclusively to the 19 inventoried node-level assertions, while all unmarked behavior (subprocess, filesystem, runtime) in the same seven mixed modules retains cross-platform execution.

The shared workflow must dispatch the base default selector to Ubuntu 3.13 and append `and not repo_policy` to the other three default selections, ensuring the 19 marked nodes execute exactly once in the primary Ubuntu 3.13 cell.

The workflow contract (two pytest sessions, no new job or runner, unchanged integration routing, intact four-cell matrix) must be verified by extending tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py to prove marked/non-marked partitioning and collection correctness.
